title: 第743章 刚出新手村就撞上炼虚大族第742章 彻底斩断退路守阵千年的贪婪目光
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
林渊顶着元婴初期的威压，双膝微颤，气血逆流间，生生逼出几声骨骼错位的闷响。
“前辈饶命！”
林渊低垂着头，声音带着恰到好处的惊惶：
“晚辈在一处古遗迹中探险，误触了残阵，莫名其妙就被传送到了这里。
“晚辈确实来自天弃之地！”
老者闻言，仰天狂笑。
“哈哈哈！
“传送阵竟然真的通了！”
老者笑声震得洞府顶部的碎石簌簌落下，他盯着林渊，眼神中满是贪婪：
“天佑我谢家！
“老夫守了这破地方整整一千年，终于等到了这天大的机缘！”
他猛地抬起枯瘦的手掌，五指虚抓。
一道青色的真元锁链凭空凝聚，如毒蛇般朝林渊缠绕而去。
“小辈，交出你身上所有的储物法宝，乖乖束手就擒。
“老夫或许还能留你个全尸！”
老者语气森寒。
林渊连声应允：
“晚辈交！
“这就交！”
他手忙脚乱地从怀里摸出一枚普通的储物戒指，用力抛向半空。

戒指里只装着几百块下品灵石，是他用来装样子的破烂。
老者的注意力瞬间被抛飞的戒指吸引，伸手便去抓。
戒指脱手的瞬间，林渊伪装的惶恐荡然无存。
袖中指尖翻飞，一枚四阶极品阵盘滑落掌心。
“阵之道，起！”
林渊在心底低喝。
嗡！
四阶极品阵盘瞬间激活，繁复的金色阵纹如水波般沿着地面疯狂蔓延，眨眼间攀爬上洞府四壁与穹顶。
一层无形的屏障轰然成型，将整座残破洞府彻底笼罩。
内部的灵力波动、声音，乃至光线，被牢牢锁在阵内，再也无法外泄分毫。
老者一把抓住那枚储物戒指，神识一扫，脸色骤变。
“几百块下品灵石？
“你耍我！”
他猛地抬头，这才惊觉四周的灵气已被彻底隔绝，一层强悍的阵法护罩不知何时已经将他困死。
“四阶阵法？”
老者勃然大怒：
content_en:
Lin Yuan resisted the pressure of the early stage of Nascent Soul, his knees trembled slightly, and as his energy and blood flowed backwards, he made several muffled sounds of bone dislocation.
"Senior, spare your life!"
Lin Yuan lowered his head, his voice filled with just the right amount of panic:
“This junior was exploring an ancient ruins, accidentally touched the remnant formation, and was transported here inexplicably.
"This junior indeed comes from a place abandoned by heaven! "
When the old man heard this, he looked up to the sky and laughed wildly.
"Hahaha!
"The teleportation array actually works!"
The old man's laughter caused the gravel on the top of the cave to fall. He stared at Lin Yuan, his eyes full of greed:
“God bless my Xie family!
"I have been guarding this poor place for a thousand years, and finally I got this great opportunity! "
He suddenly raised his skinny palm and grasped it with five fingers.
A green chain of true energy condensed out of thin air, winding towards Lin Yuan like a poisonous snake.
"Junior, hand over all the stored magic weapons you have on your body, and surrender yourself.
"Maybe I can keep your body intact!"
The old man's tone was cold.
Lin Yuan agreed repeatedly:
"Junior hand in hand!
"Here it goes! "
He hurriedly took out an ordinary storage ring from his arms and threw it into the air.
There were only a few hundred low-grade spiritual stones in the ring, which he used to show off.
The old man's attention was instantly attracted by the thrown ring, and he reached out to catch it.
The moment the ring fell from his hand, Lin Yuan's pretense of panic disappeared.
The fingertips in his sleeves flew, and a fourth-level top-grade array disk slipped from his palm.
"The way of formation, get up! "
Lin Yuan drank in his heart.
Buzz!
The fourth-level top-level array was activated instantly, and complex golden array patterns spread crazily along the ground like water waves, climbing up the walls and dome of the cave in the blink of an eye.
An invisible barrier suddenly formed, completely covering the entire ruined cave.
The internal spiritual power fluctuations, sounds, and even light are firmly locked within the formation and can no longer be leaked out.
The old man grabbed the storage ring, swept his consciousness, and his expression suddenly changed.
"A few hundred low-grade spiritual stones?
"You're kidding me!"
He raised his head suddenly, and was shocked to realize that the spiritual energy around him had been completely isolated, and a powerful formation shield had trapped him to death without knowing it.
"Level 4 formation?"
The old man was furious:
